meta.title: perf: optimize getSlots performance by selectively merging overlapping date ranges
meta.body_summary: Optimize getSlots performance by filtering out date ranges that are fully contained within other ranges, reducing ~6s processing with no behavioral change.

perf_labels.notes: Devin filtered redundant date ranges to cut getSlots processing from ~6s; maintainer approved without benchmark, citing effectiveness for date overrides.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 215 changed lines across 5 files, this is a small‑to‑medium edit by absolute volume, mainly adding a new filtering utility and adjusting the main availability file. It fits a targeted performance PR that merged quickly with maintainer approval.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer emrysal approved without changes, commenting that the optimization is 'very effective' for cases like date overrides overlapping with longer availabilities.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce getSlots processing from ~6s by pruning date ranges fully contained within others.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Application‑level date‑range optimization with clear logic; Devin succeeded without external benchmarks by providing unit tests and handling edge cases like overnight ranges.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer emrysal reviewed the approach and acknowledged its effectiveness for date override scenarios, approving without performance benchmarks.

core_change_summary.description: Added filterRedundantDateRanges utility to prune date ranges fully contained within other ranges before passing to getSlots, with special handling for overnight ranges (end < start). The filtering is applied to all scheduling types, and uniqueness is preserved before filtering.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The merge from main brought in changes to slots.ts and slots.test.ts (49 and 61 lines) which are not part of the performance optimization.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: added filterRedundantDateRanges logic and applied it to getSlots.
Fix: handle overnight date ranges where end time is before start time.
Apply filtering to all scheduling types, not just round‑robin.
Preserve uniqueness before filtering redundant ranges.
Merge from main, bringing unrelated changes to slots.ts and test files.
